ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: ……非常感谢

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: Mortis。我，毋畏死亡

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 爽世她……不知该如何是好了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
（不能失败……不许退缩——
哈啊……哈啊……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 『就像这样，小睦一直以来都不太会说话』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 爽世怎么办？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 是在月之森第一个组建乐队的，高中部的学姐

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 你真的要退学吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: ……CRYCHIC呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 我……从没觉得玩乐队开心过

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 祥……Mortis说，她不想消失

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 你甚至不会察觉，自己陷入了沉眠

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 苦瓜浇太多水会出问题的

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 我从小就一直在学芭蕾

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 拿着吉他……就会觉得安心

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 猫在聚会。看来它们知道哪里暖和

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 啊，四叶草……这是第二个了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 若麦说阳光是最大的敌人，她把不用的遮阳伞给我了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 艺术之秋……古典乐、摇滚乐还有偶像歌曲我都会听哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 踩在落叶上的声音，在耳边回响

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 给菜园做了防寒措施，希望能顺利度过这个冬天

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 下雪的日子，世界会变成白茫茫的一片

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 小时候，我和祥一起装饰过圣诞树

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 新年好。今年也请多关照

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 巧克力，我吃不了这么多。海铃，你吃吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 祥叫我今天早点睡

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 大家所期望的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 谢谢大家这么多的祝福，我会努力不辜负大家的心意的

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: Shape of My Heart
